name: Introduction to Differential Topology
description: Smooth manifolds and smooth maps, tangent spaces and derivatives, manifolds with boundary, proof of Sard's theorem, immersions and submersions, one-manifolds and some consequences, transversality, intersection theory mod 2, winding numbers, the Jordan-Brouwer separation theorem, the Borsuk-Ulam theorem and its applications, orientation, oriented intersection number, Lefschetz fixed-point theory, vector fields, the Poincare-Hopf theorem, the Hopf degree theorem, the Euler characteristic and triangulations, integration on manifolds, differential forms.
